correctness.rationale: Relabeling maps the two independent random permutations exactly to u+sigma(u). Each output absence is a derangement event; simultaneous absence of two outputs yields N/ord(h) alternating cycles each length 2ord(h); classical cycle-matching rook enumeration and exact inclusion-exclusion give Q_N(ord(h)). Summing indicator covariances yields formula. Exhaustive exact tests confirm all low-order boundaries; proofs do not depend on finite experiments.
